draft.position_summary: Acts as the first primary contact for SFU International. Responds to inquiries from domestic and international students, faculty, staff, parents, international visitors and general public regarding admissions to, studying at and programs offered through SFU International. Provides clerical and secretarial support to the Director, SFU International, Administrative Assistant, Mobility Co- ordinators, International Student Advisors, English Bridge Coordinator and other SFU International staff. Maintains confidential student records. Receives and processes a variety of fees and deposits. Schedules and co- ordinates meetings, appointments, and other events.

duties.statement: Arranges both internal and external meetings and appointments for SFU INTERNATIONAL Recruitment and Retention Staff by liaising with on and off campus personnel, visiting delegations and appropriate on campus departments/offices to fulfill the special requirements of the concerned parties

Assists in preparation of brochures, newsletters and written information by drafting/editing as required Assists in general travel, special arrangements and accommodation for visitors, members of SFU International and international students by liaising with travel agents, and relevant on and off campus personnel to successfully conclude each arrangement

Assists with scheduling events, workshops, information sessions and various orientations by booking rooms, confirming student participation and other related clerical arrangements to ensure the coordination of each occasion

Schedules student appointments by identifying the reasons for the appointment, checking Corporate Time, calendars and appointment books of the appropriate qualified staff member to ensure that each student receives prompt instructive attention
Types correspondence, reports, contracts and other material by using word processing, desktop publishing applications to prepare materials for approval, duplication and/or circulation

Performs routine clerical duties by distributing mail within the office, arranging for courier pickup and delivery, collecting curriculum relating to international activities, to facilitate the smooth operation of SFU International Services for Students
Assists in the preparation of brochures, newsletters and written information by drafting/editing as required
Maintains international student recruitment and retention publications by checking availability, and photocopying/ordering as required to ensure ready access for visitors to SFU International
Prepares and disseminates information packages and brochures to international students and domestic students by updating the written material as required, using desktop publishing application
W) Maintains general office filing support and supplies by filing correspondence, checking and ordering supplies as required to provide ready access by office personnel

model.title: International Services Coordinator
model.department: SFU International Services for Students Services for Students, Student Services
model.position_summary: The International Services Coordinator serves as the primary point of contact for domestic and international students, faculty, staff, parents, visitors and the public, providing accurate information on admissions, programs and services offered through SFU International. The role maintains confidential student records, processes fees, and supports the Director and other staff with clerical, scheduling, publishing and communication tasks. By coordinating meetings, events and travel, preparing promotional materials, supervising temporary staff and ensuring compliance with university policies, the Coordinator contributes to the effective recruitment, retention and support of international students while exercising sound judgment, intercultural communication and problem‑solving skills.
